sources.context: Official Genshin Impact Version 5.7 equipment/configuration UX details; design reference only.
Small anecdotal thread; replies specifically complain about preset naming/default-name friction and spaces. Current official resolution not established.

increments.title: Non-mutating equipment comparison
increments.acceptance: Owned compatible module/weapon previews expose exact authoritative profile deltas without mutating the live loadout; rejected previews fail atomically.

increments.title: Focus-aware owned-module recommendation
increments.acceptance: Balanced/Assault/Guard/Recovery/Mobility focuses deterministically rank only owned slot-compatible modules and never auto-equip.

increments.title: Resonance-family recommendation filter
increments.acceptance: Any/Cooling/Rift/Civic filters restrict suggestions; missing or malformed families return unavailable without mutation.

increments.title: Current-slot versus whole-build recommendation scope
increments.acceptance: CurrentSlot scores direct module contribution without newly activated family synergy; WholeBuild scores the full resulting profile and can legitimately choose a different candidate.

increments.title: Last-successful preset recall and reapply
increments.acceptance: Only successful authoritative preset application becomes remembered, including the established direct loadout apply path; failed applies do not replace it; transient encounter/training resets preserve the remembered selection; reapply routes through existing preset validation.

increments.title: Human-readable clearable preset labels with spaces
increments.acceptance: Saved slots accept bounded labels with internal spaces through their paired Shadowblade owner; invalid/cross-owner edits fail atomically; labels remain paired with saved presets across whole-loadout assignment; the public workbench view is const-only; transient resets preserve labels; label clearing does not alter the saved build or current equipment.

review_repairs: P1: CurrentSlot scoring now removes newly activated family synergy before focus scoring.
P1: The bounded task, backlog, and receipt records were added so allowed paths and gates are reviewable.
P2: Stateful preset metadata operations are bound to the paired ShadowbladeActions owner rather than accepting an arbitrary foreign loadout.
P2: ResetTransientStatePreservingLoadout preserves the new persistent preset metadata alongside the authoritative loadout.
P2: The public LoadoutWorkbench accessor is const-only, closing implicit cross-owner workbench assignment.
P2: Preset labels and last-applied metadata live in ShadowbladeLoadout so whole-loadout replacement copies or clears them atomically with the saved build.
P2: Authoritative ShadowbladeLoadout::ApplyPreset records recall on every successful apply, including the established direct mutable-loadout path, with direct-path regression coverage.
P2: The retained run receipt now lists and describes ShadowbladeLoadout.h and its metadata/bookkeeping changes.
P2: GAME-141, QOL-029, and durable coordination path inventories now include ShadowbladeLoadout.h.
P2: Backlog, STATE, and run receipt now consistently retain the complete two-P1/eight-P2 independent-review repair history.
